item.tib: dbal mo las kyis thig le drag po gting rdzogs
item.coloph: dbal gsas rngam pa khro rgyal mkha' 'gying kha la phyag 'tshal lo/ dbal mo las kyi thig le nas/ srog gi gnad them la ma tshang ba la 'di tsho mchis te/ las thig gnam lcags ngar ma'i rgyud 'di la/ gzhung las thig zer sngon kha tshangs 'di/ ma mo'i gnad gsum ni/ g.ya' ma dmar po nas/ sprul sku grol dpal gyi (gyis) gter nas bton pa'o/ las 'phro can gyis spyod par shog dam med kha byang can la ma shor cig/
